purpose: Fixed endpoint visual comparison of SEAM200, LONG, ANTI_COVER and LOCAL_NOISE, with RAW and POST reviewed separately.
row_unit: one registered request x one stage x one displayed model column

field_definitions.request_id: Exact frozen evaluation request identifier; never a selected successful subset.
field_definitions.parent_id: Frozen parent identity, not inferred from rendered appearance.
field_definitions.noise_index: Frozen noise identity; no new or relabelled noise.
field_definitions.stage: RAW or POST, matching the actual image file.
field_definitions.model: Displayed model column: SEAM200, LONG, ANTI_COVER or LOCAL_NOISE.
field_definitions.reviewer: Identifies the actual AI reviewer, for example AI_PROXY_SEAM_EVIDENCE.
field_definitions.review_kind: Always AI_PROXY; not a human rating.
field_definitions.review_status: ACTUALLY_VIEWED: reviewer opened this image and inspected this model column. Do not populate records before viewing.
field_definitions.C_adoption: YES when blue C visibly participates as a plausible part of the completed chair; NO when visibly stranded, replaced by a distinct generated layer, or otherwise unused; UNCERTAIN when occlusion or ambiguous geometry prevents this judgment. Does not require matching the source chair style.
field_definitions.whole_body_complete: YES for a visibly plausible complete chair body and supporting structure; NO for an obvious substantial missing body/support region; UNCERTAIN if not distinguishable in available views. Different reasonable styles remain admissible.
field_definitions.support_missing: YES for an obvious missing/broken support that compromises the visible chair structure; NO when no such defect is visible; UNCERTAIN for occluded/ambiguous supports. NO does not certify hidden structure.
field_definitions.fragments_or_folded_layers: YES for obvious detached pieces, crumpled/folded patches or unwanted visible multiple layers; NO when none is visible; UNCERTAIN for hidden/ambiguous geometry. Explain which appearance prompted YES.
field_definitions.visible_cracks: YES for an obvious gap or torn surface that appears structurally unintended; NO when none is visible; UNCERTAIN if a gap may be an intentional style or is obscured. Ordinary chair openings are not automatically defects.
field_definitions.visible_join: YES only for a visually continuous C-to-generated-surface connection at the rendered scale; NO for a clearly visible separation; UNCERTAIN if hidden or too small. This field never certifies indexed shared edges, legality, manifoldness, or watertightness.
field_definitions.visible_observations: Brief concrete description of visible seat/body/support/layer geometry; no invented numerical scores or source-style correctness claims.
field_definitions.change_vs_SEAM200: Concrete visible difference from SEAM200 on the same request and stage; write REFERENCE for SEAM200. Similarity is allowed; do not force a winner.
field_definitions.uncertainty: State occlusion, resolution, open-shape ambiguity and features not judgeable visually, particularly near-coplanar overlap under blue C. Preserve uncertainty rather than deriving labels from metrics.
field_definitions.image_path: Workspace-relative path of the image actually viewed.
field_definitions.image_sha256: SHA256 of that image, obtained from the saved image file.

review_rules: Inspect every assigned page and all four model columns; do not cherry-pick views or requests.
RAW and POST judgments remain separate, even for the same model and noise.
Use rendered evidence for visual fields. Numeric CF/FF/I, reachability and deletion scores do not replace image inspection or determine visual labels.
The unique source parent is not the only acceptable completion; do not rank by source-style similarity.
C adoption, body completeness, layers/cracks and visible join are independent labels; do not force mutually exclusive categories.
A blue C region can occlude near-coplanar generated geometry. Mark this limitation explicitly; absence of a visible overlap is not proof of no conflict.
No image-only certification of exact shared topology, illegal intersection, physical support, manifoldness or watertightness.
Do not write inherited or unviewed labels as ACTUALLY_VIEWED. This endpoint review has no automatic inheritance rule.
